ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, containing labels such as Cheetah, Coyote, Rattlesnake, Jackrabbit, Cottontail, Chuckwalla, Mojave Yucca, Cactus, and Shrub. Shrub is located at the lower right of the diagram, and there is an arrow pointing from Shrub to Cottontail in the middle. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows point from food to the organism that eats that food. Therefore, the organism receiving the arrow from Shrub is Cottontail.
